Record Class AssembleRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.knowledge.spi.AssembleRequest
Record Components:
storeRoot - the store's root directory
cleanStart - whether to delete the store root before assembling
inputs - the artifacts, in load order; an ArtifactInput.Role.STORE_SEED is valid only in first position
view - the view specification; ViewSpec.empty() means all implementation defaults
classify - whether to run classification as the final step (the default posture — assembly completes its effect)
reasonerService - the reasoner-service simple name when several are present — an implementation selection, distinct from ViewSpec.LOGIC_CLASSIFIER, the classifier concept that authors derived semantics
installDirectory - a directory to copy the assembled store into (for example a data-source directory a knowledge browser reads)
reasonedPbFile - the file to export the classified store to as a full standalone reasoned protobuf — the reasoned-pb classifier form, inferred results baked in (IKE-Network/ike-issues#933); empty means no export; requires classify
public record AssembleRequest(Path storeRoot, boolean cleanStart, List<ArtifactInput> inputs, ViewSpec view, boolean classify, Optional<String> reasonerService, Optional<Path> installDirectory, Optional<Path> reasonedPbFile) extends Record
A knowledge-base assembly request: ordered inputs into a store at a root, classified by default under the given view (IKE-Network/ike-issues#848, #850).

    • AssembleRequest

      public AssembleRequest(Path storeRoot, boolean cleanStart, List<ArtifactInput> inputs, ViewSpec view, boolean classify, Optional<String> reasonerService, Optional<Path> installDirectory, Optional<Path> reasonedPbFile)
      Validates and defensively copies the request.
      Parameters:
      storeRoot - the store's root directory
      cleanStart - whether to delete the store root before assembling
      inputs - the artifacts, in load order
      view - the view specification
      classify - whether to run classification as the final step
      reasonerService - the reasoner-service simple name when several are present
      installDirectory - a directory to copy the assembled store into
      reasonedPbFile - the reasoned-protobuf export file; empty means no export
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if any component is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if inputs is empty, an ArtifactInput.Role.STORE_SEED appears after the first position, or a reasoned-protobuf export is requested without classification
